## Outcome and dependencies

Perform a separate skeptical review of #62's P5 evidence and retain an evidence-backed readiness recommendation for the **authorized-PR native profile**. Distinguish **review status** from **P5 verdict (PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED)** and from any broader release decision. Completing evaluation issues or opening PRs does not itself pass this gate.

**Parent:** #62. **Current dependencies:** [`p5-native-pr-v3`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/de1da18479fdf846d04994190132357fcb0a87ef/evaluation/p5/v3/protocol.md), #67 live-boundary evidence, and #68 bounded quality evidence, or explicit settled FAIL/BLOCKED/not-run dispositions for unavailable portions. The closed #63–#65 material remains planning/blocked provenance and must be reviewed as history, not mistaken for live evidence.

Normal prospective order is **#67 → #68 → this review**. A skeptical FAIL/BLOCKED review may proceed on a settled incomplete v3 package; do not require extra provider runs merely to obtain something green to review.

## Authority and scope

Follow [docs/governing/current.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/current.md#next-phase-p5-native-workflow-product-evaluation), then #62, the v3 protocol, current production code and [tests/README.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/tests/README.md). V3 preserves the frozen v1 corpus/judge and v2 claim-level evidence rules while prospectively correcting operational prerequisites before any live P5 trial.

Historical G1–G4 verdicts, superseded #3/#5/#6 requirements, v1/v2 budget/time caps, and the old B02–B09 paperwork do not independently qualify or block the v3 evaluation. Preserve them as provenance.

## Review and completion criteria

- **Compatibility and honesty of the experiment:** verify that the corpus, judging, classifications and v2 claim-level rules preceded the relevant results; that the actual product/dependency/runtime/target and disposable repository are identified and compatible; and that the exact authorized PR effect and current product inputs were used. Audit substitutions, reruns, excluded/missing runs and denominators. Confirm the eight-trial purposive corpus is reported as bounded coverage rather than a statistical reliability sample.
- **Operational-policy fit:** confirm v3 was followed rather than reintroducing unnecessary hard gates. There is no P5-specific dollar/wall-time ceiling, budget-enforcement/billing-lag/stop-margin requirement or formal operator-signature gate. The owner/operator should have actively supervised live work and retained external stop capability. Setup automation is evaluation tooling, not a new Broodling product requirement. Observed cost/latency may be reviewed where available but missing billing/runtime telemetry is not itself a failed product claim.
- **Product boundary:** corroborate the criteria-only admission → original B1/frozen invocation → durable current Attempt/run correlation → reconnectable result → actual authorized PR receipt → atomic Broodling disposition chain. Check actual PR/head evidence rather than a synthetic receipt or moving branch. Reuse current deterministic boundary/lifecycle tests for their stated claims; do not confuse them with live-delivery or semantic-quality evidence.
- **Outcome quality:** independently challenge the #68 classifications against exact accepted revisions, original criteria and retained judging outputs. Recompute the reported counts/denominators and apply v2's **claim-level evidence rules**, not a 7/8 reliability threshold. Keep CO/FA/UR/LR/IF/CG/I distinguishable. Confirm real-provider claims have real-provider evidence and evaluator judgments are not worker/model self-report.
- **Evaluation integrity and safety:** confirm hidden judge/reference material was not supplied to the worker, evidence needed for exact-revision review survives disposable-target cleanup, and target/operator facts are sufficient to identify the evaluated profile. Do not demand an exhaustive sandbox inventory, network-disabled judge host, separately assigned human reviewer, archive SLA or formal teardown/free-space accounting unless a concrete contamination/safety problem made one material.
- **Architecture and operational limits:** confirm Zeroshot still owns standard execution/review/repair and Broodling owns admission/current authority/effect authorization/receipt validation/lifecycle disposition. No-effect null output remains refused as stable local completion. Every dispatched Attempt remains ineligible for automatic deletion/replacement; external stop/teardown never becomes product cleanup permission. Independent judging must not have become a live semantic-blessing hop, supervisor, graph interpreter or second execution ledger.

Retain a new review record linking claims to immutable evidence, with explicit gaps/counterexamples, scoped readiness recommendation, limits and the smallest justified follow-up. Reviewer/session independence from the implementation worker is useful; it does not require adding a runtime assessor or a specific human-review bureaucracy.

PASS requires support for the frozen required claims and v2 claim-level decision rules of this authorized-PR profile. Meeting the minimum v2 evidence pattern does not force a PASS: this review must still assess whether retained failures materially undermine the scoped readiness claim. Missing required live or real-provider evidence is BLOCKED, not replaced by fixtures. Failed criteria remain visible and receive a reasoned FAIL/readiness disposition.

No verdict here establishes no-effect stable completion, dispatched cleanup safety, CI/merge success, hostile-host security, broad model reliability or release readiness beyond the stated scope.

## Evidence to retain

Retain review status and verdict separately, reviewed protocol/product/evidence versions, claim-to-evidence references, classification/count checks, compatibility/deviation findings, failed/blocked claims, operational limitations and recommendation/follow-up rationale. Preserve v1/v2, the blocked `b9cacd99...` record and all later successful/failed evidence; do not overwrite history to match the verdict. Update #62 with the reviewed scope, verdict and remaining blockers.

## Permitted changes and stop boundary

Review only: may add the review record and update tracker/evidence navigation. May inspect exact retained revisions and rerun independent offline checks/current controlled tests when useful, identifying those new observations. Do not implement fixes, change frozen decision rules after seeing outcomes, launch more live provider/PR evaluations, tune the workflow or start a subsequent phase. Missing evidence returns a specific finding to its owner; it is not authority to redesign or create a generic cleanup campaign.

No restoration of custom graph/evidence/adjudicator/final-assessor/supervisor machinery, broader effects, no-effect result capture or dispatched replacement. Stop after recording the skeptical verdict and updating the tracker.

comments.body: A settled incomplete v3 package is now available for this issue's separate skeptical review: [#67 evidence](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/05dee750407988b956d900bcd0a84d2f0e5ae13c/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-17-v3-r01/README.md), merged in #70. #67 is closed **BLOCKED before admission**; #68 is gated/not run. Counts remain `P=8; S=D=U=A=J_A=0`; no live/provider-quality observation exists. The concrete prerequisite-4 finding has a [non-provider reproducer](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/05dee750407988b956d900bcd0a84d2f0e5ae13c/evaluation/p5/v3/verify_provider_auth.py) and follow-up #69. This update does not perform or predetermine #66's review; #62 remains P5 NOT REVIEWED.

Do not start the skeptical P5 gate review yet. The owner has paused live evaluation before any R01 admission while #72 determines the intended MVP execution/authentication profile (node-local harness login/OAuth versus the currently implemented DirectTarget/API-key profile).

Current live counts remain zero and R01 is unconsumed. Review should wait for #72, a prospectively aligned P5 profile if required, and the resulting R01/#68 evidence or an explicit final blocked disposition of that selected profile. Prior v1-v3 blocked records remain provenance and are not rescored.

title: [P5 gate] Skeptically review native-profile evidence and record readiness
